strategicModel.classificationRationale: The business is trustworthy attribution and exact payment: a link that belongs to one customer, an order traced to that customer, and a payout made once from the approved commission. Linking, Order Tracking and Cashback Payouts are core. Identity, Campaigns and Customer Conversation support them. Deals and Operations are generic.

subdomains.name: Attribution and cashback
subdomains.description: Issuing attributable links, tracking orders and paying cashback.

subdomains.name: Customer engagement
subdomains.description: Who the customer is, how we talk to them, and promotions.

contexts.name: Customer Identity
contexts.description: Who a customer is, how the customer is recognised from Zalo and the web, and who may act as staff.
contexts.businessCapability: Recognise customers and staff, and keep each customer's permanent identity

aggregates.name: Customer
aggregates.description: A person who earns cashback. It holds the permanent customer id, the customer code, the bank account and the sign-in secret. The customer id never changes.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: customer id, customer code, aliases, role, bank account with consent, password and lock state.
invariants: The customer id never changes once a link carries it.
A customer code is issued once from a counter that only goes up and is never reused.
A customer id that is an alias of another customer cannot become a new customer.
Staff and the guest account have no customer code.

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Today the Zalo UID seen by the assistant account.

fields.name: customerCode
fields.description: DP plus five digits, shown to the customer and used to sign in.

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: Old Zalo UIDs and retired codes that point here.

fields.name: bankAccount
fields.description: Bank, account number and holder name, saved with consent.

lifecycle.description: A customer is active until staff disable the account, merge it into another, or erase it.

transitions.description: Five failed sign-ins lock the account for 15 minutes.
Staff disable the account. It can no longer sign in.
The operator merges a duplicate into the surviving customer. Its ids become aliases.
The operator erases the customer and the customer's history.

rules.description: A customer is created only from Zalo intent: the first private message or the first product link pasted in the group (D25). The public web never creates a customer.
An unknown customer code on the web is answered as not found. It never becomes a guest link.
A customer is found by customer code, customer id or alias, ignoring case and spaces.
Two customers with different bank accounts are never merged.
A customer who is still owed money is not erased unless the operator forces it (D13).
A bank account is saved only with the customer's consent time, and only the last four digits are shown.
Issuing a new password ends every other session of that customer (D21).
The root admin account cannot be demoted or disabled.

aggregates.name: Session
aggregates.description: A signed-in browser of a customer or staff member. Only a hash of the token is stored.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: token hash, owner and expiry.
invariants: Only the hash of a session token is stored.

rules.description: A session renews itself when it is used, so a customer stays signed in on a trusted phone.

events.name: CustomerRegistered
events.description: A new customer was registered from Zalo. Linking may now issue links under the customer id.

events.name: BankAccountChanged
events.description: A customer saved or erased a bank account. Payouts read the new account; a recent change raises a review flag.

events.name: CustomersMerged
events.description: A duplicate customer was merged into a survivor. Old ids keep resolving to the survivor.

events.name: CustomerErased
events.description: A customer and the customer's history were erased.

events.name: CustomerLocked
events.description: Too many failed sign-ins locked the account for 15 minutes.

useCases.name: Register from Zalo
useCases.description: The assistant registers a person it has just seen in a private chat or the group.

useCases.name: Sign in on the web
useCases.description: A customer signs in with the customer code and password.

useCases.name: Issue a password
useCases.description: A customer asks the assistant for a new password with /matkhau.

useCases.name: Save a bank account
useCases.description: A customer saves or erases bank details in chat or on the web.

useCases.name: Merge duplicate customers
useCases.description: The operator reviews proposed pairs and merges each duplicate into the survivor.

contexts.name: Link Issuing
contexts.description: Turns a product URL into an affiliate link that belongs to exactly one customer, and delivers it.
contexts.businessCapability: Issue attributable affiliate links fast, without risking the affiliate accounts

aggregates.name: LinkRequest
aggregates.description: One customer's request to turn one product URL into an affiliate link. It holds the source URL, the affiliate link, the share link and the estimate shown. It must never carry another customer's id.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: owner, network, source URL, affiliate link, sub_ids, share code, estimate and delivery time.
invariants: A link request belongs to exactly one customer, written in sub_id1 (D6).
Every sub_id holds letters and digits only (D7).
An affiliate link is attached once and never replaced.
One share code belongs to one link request.

fields.name: subIds
fields.description: sub_id1 is the customer id, sub_id2 the request id.

fields.name: estimate
fields.description: Price, rates and estimated cashback at request time. Reference only.

fields.name: deliveredAt
fields.description: Set by whoever hands the link over first.

lifecycle.description: A link request waits in the link queue, gets its affiliate link, is delivered, and is converted when an order arrives. Leaving the attribution window is derived from time, not stored (D23).

transitions.description: The browser bridge returns the affiliate link for this request.
Three counted attempts failed. Captcha and page errors are retried without counting.
sideEffects: The customer is told the link could not be made.

transitions.description: The assistant or the web hands the link to the customer.
The notifier sends a link unclaimed after 55 seconds and younger than 2 hours.
Reconciliation records an order attributed to this request.

rules.description: A link is reused only for the same customer and the same source URL inside the attribution window. Product facts may be shared across customers.
Guest requests reuse one HOUSE link per product (D5).
One browser submission carries one customer only, because the network applies one sub_id to the whole batch (D7).
A request that already has an affiliate link refuses another one, and a link already stored for a different source URL is refused as a stale page answer.
A late link is sent only between 55 seconds and 2 hours after it was issued. Older links are marked delivered without a message.
The website may issue 60 new links per hour in total and 20 per customer code per day. Zalo has no quota.
The link queue serves Zalo first, then web customers, then guests, then the oldest request.
Every call to Shopee goes through the operator's signed-in browser. No forged signatures, and commission lookups read page 1 only (D8).
Chat always delivers the share link, because purchases inside the Zalo in-app browser are not attributed.
An affiliate link never expires. The attribution window only decides when a repeat request makes a fresh link (D23).

aggregates.name: ProductOffer
aggregates.description: The shared facts of one product on one network: price, commission rates, cap flag and estimated cashback. It holds no customer data.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: price, Shopee rate, shop rate and the capped estimate.
invariants: Shopee's part of the estimate is capped at 40,000 dong; the shop's XTRA part is not (D2).

rules.description: The 20 most requested products are refreshed when older than 6 hours.

aggregates.name: LinkClick
aggregates.description: One visit to a share link by a person. Preview bots and HEAD requests are not recorded.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: share code, time and browser kind.
invariants: A click always belongs to an existing share code.

events.name: LinkIssued
events.description: The browser bridge returned the affiliate link. The waiting assistant or web page can deliver it.

events.name: LinkDelivered
events.description: The customer received the link. It is never sent again.

events.name: LinkFailed
events.description: The link could not be made after three attempts. The customer is told.

useCases.name: Request a link in Zalo
useCases.description: A customer pastes a product link in chat. The assistant waits up to 52 seconds and replies with the share link.

useCases.name: Request a link on the web
useCases.description: A customer or guest pastes a product link on the website and gets the affiliate link or a guest warning.

useCases.name: Open a share link
useCases.description: A buyer opens hoantiendp.com/s/<code>. A real browser is redirected; an in-app browser is guided out first.

contexts.name: Order Tracking
contexts.description: Reads the networks' conversion reports, attributes each order to a customer, and follows it to approval or cancellation.
contexts.businessCapability: Know exactly which customer earned which approved commission

aggregates.name: Order
aggregates.description: One purchase a network reported, attributed to one customer. It holds the order value, the estimated and approved commission and the cashback owed. A paid order never changes.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: owner, network, status, estimated and approved commission, cashback, paid time and status history.
invariants: Cashback is calculated from the approved commission only (D3).
An order with a paid time is never changed or paid again (D4).
An approved order is never rejected later.
A guest order always has 0 cashback and is never moved to another customer (D5).
Every status change is appended to the status history.

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: The network's order number or transaction id.

fields.name: cashback
fields.description: Derived from the approved commission by the commission split.

fields.name: recordedAt
fields.description: When the platform first recorded the order. Campaign ranking uses it.

fields.name: settlement
fields.description: Whether the network has paid the operator for this order.

lifecycle.description: A recorded order waits for the network's approval, then waits for the operator's payout.

transitions.description: Reconciliation sees the network approve the order with a commission figure. The cashback becomes owed.
sideEffects: The customer is told the amount, without a payout date (D11).

transitions.description: Reconciliation sees the network cancel the order.
sideEffects: The customer is told the reason.

transitions.description: A payout covering this order is recorded.

rules.description: Reconciliation attributes an order by sub_id1, then by customer alias, then by the owner of the sub_id2 request. Anything else goes to manual review.
An order is approved only when the report carries a commission figure; otherwise it goes to manual review.
Only an approved order without a paid time can be marked paid (D4).
Running reconciliation again over the same period leaves every order unchanged.
A report status the system does not know goes to manual review instead of a guess.
Shopee's completed, delivered and paid statuses mean awaiting approval. Only validated or approved means approved.
AccessTrade lines are grouped per transaction. The order is approved only when every non-rejected line is confirmed, and rejected when every line is rejected.

aggregates.name: ReviewCase
aggregates.description: A report row the system will not guess at, waiting for the operator. One open case per order and reason.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: order id, reason, report row and resolution.
invariants: Only one open review case exists per order and reason.

transitions.description: The operator applies or dismisses the row.

events.name: OrderRecorded
events.description: A network reported a new attributed order. The customer is told the estimate; campaigns may give it a slot.

events.name: OrderApproved
events.description: The network approved the order. The cashback is now owed to the customer.

events.name: OrderRejected
events.description: The network cancelled the order. No cashback is owed; a held campaign slot is freed.

events.name: OrderPaid
events.description: A payout covered the order. It never changes again.

useCases.name: Reconcile a network report
useCases.description: Every hour the system reads each network's report and records, approves or rejects orders.

useCases.name: View my orders
useCases.description: A customer reads the order list and balance with /donhang or on the web.

useCases.name: Resolve a manual review
useCases.description: The operator decides a report row the system would not guess at.

contexts.name: Cashback Payouts
contexts.description: Turns approved cashback into bank transfers the operator makes, and tracks what the networks paid the operator.
contexts.businessCapability: Pay every customer exactly what is owed, once

aggregates.name: Payout
aggregates.description: One bank transfer the operator made to one customer. It covers that customer's approved, unpaid orders and confirmed bonuses. It holds the amount, the transfer reference, the proof and the bill token.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: customer, covered orders, covered bonuses, amount, reference, proof and bill token.
invariants: A payout covers only approved orders without a paid time, and only confirmed campaign bonuses (D19).
The payout amount equals the sum of the cashback and bonuses it covers, computed by the server.
A payout is never made to a customer without a bank account.
A guest order is never covered by a payout (D5).

fields.name: reference
fields.description: The customer code only, no commercial wording.

fields.name: billToken
fields.description: 24 random bytes; opens the public bill page.

rules.description: Every approved, unpaid order is payable. The operator decides when to pay, and no message promises a date (D11).
Every payout goes through one command that checks status, paid time and bonus state, and writes the order history (D19).
A bank account changed in the last 72 hours raises a flag before the operator pays.
Only staff may record a payout.

aggregates.name: NetworkSettlement
aggregates.description: One payment a network made to the operator. It settles the approved orders it covers. It is separate from paying customers.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: batch id, network, amount, status and settled orders.
invariants: Settlement never changes an order's customer status.

events.name: PayoutRecorded
events.description: The operator recorded a transfer. The covered orders become paid and the customer gets one message with the bill link.

useCases.name: Pay a customer
useCases.description: The operator opens the payable list, transfers by QR, and records the payout with proof.

useCases.name: Ask for a bank account
useCases.description: The operator asks a customer who is owed money to add a bank account.

contexts.name: Campaigns
contexts.description: Limited events that give a bonus to the first N qualifying orders recorded inside a time window.

aggregates.name: Campaign
aggregates.description: One promotion: its window, number of slots, bonus, minimum order value, networks, excluded customers and per-customer cap. It owns its slots.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: window, slot count and every award with its state.
invariants: The number of held, confirmed and paid awards never exceeds the slot count.
A slot belongs to an order, not a person.
Staff, the guest account and excluded customers never hold a slot.

lifecycle.description: A campaign opens at its start time and closes at its end time (D22).

transitions.description: The window ends. Freed slots are no longer refilled.

rules.description: Slots go to qualifying orders recorded inside the window, earliest first.
A slot freed by a cancellation passes to the next order only while the campaign is running.
A bonus is paid only together with the approved order's cashback. A held slot is never paid.
The window end is exclusive in every calculation.

aggregates.name: CampaignAward
aggregates.description: One slot of a campaign held by one order.
invariants: One order holds at most one award per campaign.

transitions.description: A payout covered the order and its bonus.

events.name: SlotHeld
events.description: An order took a campaign slot. The order-recorded message mentions it.

events.name: SlotLost
events.description: An order lost its slot because it was cancelled. The customer is told.

useCases.name: Create a campaign
useCases.description: An admin creates a campaign as one new record, not new code.

contexts.name: Customer Conversation
contexts.description: Talks to customers in Zalo through one personal account, and sends the notifications the system starts on its own.
contexts.businessCapability: Reach every customer in chat without getting the Zalo account locked

aggregates.name: Notification
aggregates.description: A message the system starts on its own: late link, failed link, order recorded, approved, rejected, paid, slot held or lost. It is derived from the gap between what happened and what the customer was told.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: subject, customer, kind and sent state.
invariants: A customer is told each change once.
A guest never receives a notification (D5).
No notification promises a payout date (D11).
A paid notification is never sent for 0 dong.

rules.description: The assistant keeps a human pace: no bulk messages, no bulk friend requests, at most 30 friend requests a day to people who wrote first (D9).
A failed send waits 1, 2, 4 minutes and so on, up to one hour.
Every message text comes from the Vietnamese message catalog. Every percentage carries an example amount in dong.
One Zalo account runs one session. Dev and test use another account.

useCases.name: Use chat commands
useCases.description: A customer types /id, /sodu, /donhang, /stk, /matkhau or pastes a link. Private data is answered in a private chat only.

useCases.name: Announce to the group
useCases.description: The operator previews an announcement in the test group, then sends it to the main group.

contexts.name: Deals
contexts.description: Featured products and food-and-drink vouchers the operator shows to bring customers back.

aggregates.name: Deal
aggregates.description: One featured product in a category, shown on the website and with /topdeal.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: product, category and active flag.
invariants: Only active deals are shown.

aggregates.name: Voucher
aggregates.description: A counter code for a food-and-drink brand.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: brand, code and active flag.
invariants: Only active vouchers are shown.

contexts.name: Operations
contexts.description: The audit trail, the owner alerts, the fraud checks and the business metrics the operator reads.
contexts.businessCapability: See what happened and spot abuse

aggregates.name: AuditEntry
aggregates.description: One append-only record of a business act: link, order, payout, bank change, sign-in, erasure.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: act, actor, subject and time.
invariants: An audit entry is never changed.
A bank account appears only as a fingerprint.

rules.description: The fraud checks flag a bank account shared by several customers, frequent bank changes, a high rejection share, and bursts of link requests.
Business metrics are marked untrustworthy below 100 approved orders.

relations.description: Linking resolves a customer code or alias to the permanent customer id before it issues a link.
Order Tracking resolves sub_id1 and aliases to the customer.
An order references the link request it came from; recording it converts the request.
Payouts adds approved cashback to the payable balance and marks orders paid through a command.
Payouts reads the customer's bank account to build the QR.
Campaigns gives, confirms or frees slots when orders are recorded, approved or rejected.
A payout covers the confirmed bonuses of the orders it pays.
Customer Conversation tells customers about recorded, approved, rejected and paid orders.
Customer Conversation delivers issued, late and failed links.

buildingBlocks.name: LinkRequest

buildingBlocks.name: SubId

buildingBlocks.name: ShareCode

buildingBlocks.name: LinkReusePolicy

buildingBlocks.name: LinkQueue

buildingBlocks.name: AffiliateNetworkPort

buildingBlocks.name: Order

buildingBlocks.name: OrderAttribution

buildingBlocks.name: ReconciliationRun

buildingBlocks.name: ConversionReportTranslator

buildingBlocks.name: Payout

buildingBlocks.name: PayableBalance

buildingBlocks.name: VietQrAdapter

buildingBlocks.name: BillToken

buildingBlocks.name: Campaign
buildingBlocks.purpose: Owns the window, the slots and every award.

buildingBlocks.name: SlotEvaluation

buildingBlocks.name: Notifier

buildingBlocks.name: ZaloAssistantPort
buildingBlocks.purpose: Sends a private or group message through the assistant.

buildingBlocks.name: MessageCatalog
buildingBlocks.purpose: The Vietnamese message texts, outside the code.

buildingBlocks.name: ShopeeAdapter
buildingBlocks.purpose: Shopee links and commission lookups go through the operator's signed-in Chrome (D8). Via: Browser bridge.

buildingBlocks.name: ShopeeReportAdapter
buildingBlocks.purpose: Shopee conversion reports are read page by page through the same browser. Via: Browser bridge report reader.

buildingBlocks.name: AccessTradeAdapter
buildingBlocks.purpose: TikTok Shop links are created through AccessTrade with sub1 and sub2. Via: AccessTrade API.

buildingBlocks.name: AccessTradeReportAdapter
buildingBlocks.purpose: AccessTrade transactions are grouped per order and translated. Via: AccessTrade transactions API.

buildingBlocks.name: ZcaJsAdapter
buildingBlocks.purpose: All chat goes through one personal Zalo account (D9). Via: zca-js personal account.

decisions.decision: Every amount is a whole number of dong. Money rounds half-up through one shared helper.
decisions.rationale: Python round() and JS Math.round() round half to even or toward infinity; every tool in the market shows 9,263 for 9,262.5. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: Shopee's part of a commission is capped at 40,000 dong per order. The shop's XTRA part is not capped.
decisions.rationale: Checked on 18 of 18 products. Forgetting the cap promised almost three times the real amount. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: Cashback is calculated from the approved commission only, never from the estimate shown to the customer.
decisions.rationale: The estimate changes or disappears after returns; paying from it loses money. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: An order with a payout time (paid_at) is never changed or paid again.
decisions.rationale: Reconciliation runs over overlapping periods; without this lock one order is paid two or three times. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: A link made without a customer code belongs to the guest account HOUSE. A guest link never earns cashback, and its orders are never moved to a customer who registers later.
decisions.rationale: All guests are the same payee, so one link per product is enough and the operator keeps the commission. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: A link belongs to exactly one customer through sub_id1. A link is reused only for the same customer; product facts (price, rates) may be shared.
decisions.rationale: Reusing a link by product sent customer B's money to customer A in production (fixed on 2026-09-25). Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: Every sub_id holds letters and digits only, and one link batch never mixes customers.
decisions.rationale: A dash silently breaks attribution; the network applies one sub_id to every link in a batch. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: Every call to Shopee goes through the operator's real signed-in browser. No code rebuilds Shopee's signature headers or calls its internal APIs directly.
decisions.rationale: The Open API was refused on 2026-09-10; direct calls put the whole session into captcha; forged signatures risk the affiliate account. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: Customer chat runs on one personal Zalo account at a human pace. No bulk messages and no bulk friend requests.
decisions.rationale: The Zalo Bot API is gone since 2026-09-25. A locked account cuts contact with every customer at once. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: Only the Zalo assistant creates customers. The public web signs in or accepts an existing code; an unknown code is not found.
decisions.rationale: The assistant has just seen the person in Zalo; the web cannot prove who someone is. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: Every approved, unpaid order is payable, grouped by customer. The operator decides when to pay, so no message promises a date.
decisions.rationale: The old 50,000 dong threshold was a rule customers could not see or act on. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: The approved commission is split as service fee 0.98%, withheld tax 10% in a withheld period, then net. Cashback is 80% of net; the operator keeps the rest.
decisions.rationale: These are the rates the live system pays today. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: A customer who is still owed money is never deleted, except by an explicit forced action of the operator.
decisions.rationale: Deleting such a customer loses a debt the operator must still pay. Confirmed as carried over (OQ6); Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: The platform is re-planned from scratch: domain model, UX, architecture and PRD come before any code. The current Python system and the earlier v2 TypeScript code are reference only.
decisions.rationale: The owner wants the web and the architecture redesigned and optimized; the earlier v2 design documents are not in the repository.

decisions.decision: Code, docs, the domain model, decisions and logs are written in English. Chat follows the person's language. Customer-facing text is Vietnamese and lives only in the message and label files.
decisions.rationale: One ubiquitous language in documents and code; customers read Vietnamese.

decisions.decision: Planning documents (docs/, .context/, _bmad-output/) are committed. The GitHub repository is made private first.
decisions.rationale: The earlier v2 design documents were lost because they were never committed.

decisions.decision: The first release supports Shopee and TikTok Shop through AccessTrade. Lazada stays out until a later decision.
decisions.rationale: Shopee and AccessTrade are live today; both entry points already refuse Lazada links. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: The Link Issuing context owns the affiliate network catalog: caps, sub_id format, link creation and report shape per network. Other contexts read it as published language.
decisions.rationale: Network rules change together with link creation; one owner avoids two copies drifting, as the Shopee domain list once did. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: Every payout goes through one command. It covers only approved orders without a paid time and only confirmed bonuses, and it writes the order history.
decisions.rationale: The live admin confirm-payment screen skips these checks and can pay awaiting or already-paid orders. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: The commission split is one function in the shared money package, with a fee rate and a tax rule per network. The customer share is 80% of net on every network.
decisions.rationale: Today Shopee, AccessTrade and the estimates each use a different formula. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: Issuing a new password ends every other session of that customer.
decisions.rationale: A customer who asks for a new password expects the old access to stop. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: A campaign closes automatically at the end of its window, and the window end is exclusive everywhere.
decisions.rationale: Today nothing closes a campaign and the v2 code disagreed with Python on the window end. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: A link request has no expired state. Being outside the attribution window is derived from the request time.
decisions.rationale: The expired state was bookkeeping only, misled readers into thinking the link stopped working, and its job ran only in one entry point. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option).

decisions.decision: An admin can void a payout recorded by mistake. The covered orders return to approved and their bonuses to confirmed, with history and audit. Reconciliation still never changes a paid order.
decisions.rationale: A mistaken payout otherwise has no correction path; a compensating command keeps D4 intact for every automatic path. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option, from the PRD review).

decisions.decision: The assistant registers a person on the first private message or the first product link pasted in the community group. Group membership alone registers no one.
decisions.rationale: Most group members never request a link; registering them creates empty rows and noise in merges. Answers OQ7. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option, from the PRD review).

decisions.decision: Erasing a customer removes the personal data and keeps the orders, payouts and audit entries under the permanent customer id.
decisions.rationale: Deleting ledger rows breaks D4 and the append-only audit trail; the privacy law needs the personal data gone, not the money record. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option, from the PRD review).

decisions.decision: Payable means approved and not paid, whether or not the network has settled it. Settlement is separate information. Every screen, chat reply and export uses this one definition.
decisions.rationale: Today 'ready' has three definitions and the customer page, the customer list and the payments queue disagree. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option, from the PRD review).

decisions.decision: Every instant is stored as UTC in one format. Business days, weeks, months and campaign windows are computed in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, and a date range includes its whole end day.
decisions.rationale: Three stored time formats compared as text make date filters return nothing and campaigns open 7 hours late. Delegated to Claude by the project owner on 2026-10-30 (recommended option, from the PRD review).
